title: CHART: A Harness-Rotation Curriculum for Harness-Robust Search Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.22247v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Search agents are usually trained under a single harness. But once an agent is deployed in a real application, its harness is frequently updated (e.g., a rewritten system prompt) to fit production needs. This exposes a fragility of post-trained agents: because a learned behavior is entangled with its training harness, even a harness update that leaves the task unchanged can fail to elicit the behavior. We train a search agent to perform parallel search, a popular strategy for improving both search efficiency and performance. We find that training under a fixed harness makes the behavior harness-local, overfit to that harness's surface form: when the harness changes, the model falls back to serial search. An intuitive fix is harness augmentation, but simply training on more harnesses does not resolve the problem. translated_title: CHART：一种用于训练框架鲁棒搜索代理的框架轮换课程
translated_abstract: 搜索代理通常在单一框架（harness）下训练。但一旦代理被部署到实际应用中，其框架会频繁更新（例如重写系统提示词）以满足生产需求。这暴露了后训练代理的一个脆弱性：由于学习到的行为与训练框架紧密纠缠，即使框架更新后任务本身不变，也可能无法再引出该行为。我们训练一个搜索代理执行并行搜索——这是一种同时提升搜索效率和性能的流行策略。我们发现，在固定框架下训练会使该行为局限于特定框架，即对框架的表面形式过拟合：当框架改变时，模型会退回到串行搜索。一个直观的修复方法是框架增强，但仅仅在更多框架上训练并不能解决问题。GRPO从同一问题的并行与串行 rollout 之间的奖励差距中学习：较小的框架池会使该差距饱和……
tldr: 提出CHART框架轮换课程训练方法，使搜索代理在框架更新后仍能保持并行搜索等已学行为，解决了后训练代理对训练框架表面形式过拟合的脆弱性问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes CHART, a harness-rotation curriculum that enables search agents to retain learned behaviors like parallel search even when their harness is updated, addressing the fragility of post-trained agents that overfit to their training harness's surface form.
